text: FactSales is already a well-modeled Delta table, so this project queries it directly through a lakehouse SQL endpoint — no separate warehouse, no data copy, just a straightforward GROUP BY.
Fabric's Direct Lake mode reads the Delta table's Parquet files straight into a semantic model — no scheduled import, no per-click round-trip.
The dashboard is only as fresh as the gold table underneath it. Online sales flow through in minutes; in-store sales land the next morning.
Choosing how something reads FactSales is separate from what FactSales looks like. Getting the serving choice wrong doesn't mean redoing the modeling work.
A dashboard that inherits its freshness honestly, from a pipeline it doesn't control. Next up: hardening this whole system for production.
